messages:
Nora (Docs): starting a quick thread to finalize the release note & migration tip for the embed routing change. aiming for a short 'what changed' + 2-line migration note.
Eli (Product): keep it simple: default is latency-first now, there's a deterministic opt-in, and a minor cache-warmup ordering caveat.
Rina (SDK): i'll prepare JS + Python snippets. question: are we using `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` or `route_hint: \"conservative\"`?
Omar (Eng): runtime uses `deterministic`. also changed alias `embed-fast` -> `embed-v2-lowlatency`. we put redirects in place but callout the new name.
Nora (Docs): draft migration line: "If precise token ordering matters, set `route_hint: \"deterministic\"` until cache alignment completes (may slightly increase latency)."
Eli (Product): good. add a one-line known-issue: "Initial requests after cache cold-start can show minor token-order differences; KB link TBD."
Rina (SDK): adding the same note to SDK README and example comments. snippets will be single-block (no tables) to keep mobile friendly.
docs-preview: Preview deployed for docs PR 5340: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-5340 :white_check_mark:
Nora (Docs): sample curl i'll include: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-v2-lowlatency","route_hint":"latency","input":"hello"}'
```
Omar (Eng): confirm we will publish the KB entry by Thursday. i'll put a placeholder link in the draft.
Eli (Product): timeline: target publish Friday morning. if anything slips, loop support and marketing.
Nora (Docs): checklist: 1) SDK snippets (rina) 2) KB page (omar) 3) preview review (eli) 4) TOC anchor + known-issues section (nora). tagging reviewers now.
Rina (SDK): will PR SDK changes tomorrow.
Omar (Eng): KB stub done Wed.
Nora (Docs): thanks team — i'll merge once everything is green and post a short announcement.
